description: Tsinghua’s student AI growth assistant, Xiaoda (清小搭).
howToObtain: Use the official Xiaoda web portal or WeChat mini-program. A 29 September 2026 university-hosted report states access opened to all undergraduate and graduate students in June 2025; an undated center page retains the older 2024-cohort pilot wording. Authenticated eligibility and feature access were not tested.
costToUser: Not specified in the reviewed current sources; no price or free-access promise verified.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: In 2024, Tsinghua launched a suite of transformative artificial intelligence (AI) educational tools, including ‘Xiaoda’ — a student AI growth assistant. The chatbot-style interface was introduced to all incoming freshmen to enhance their learning experiences, offer life guidance, deepen their self-awareness, and promote their holistic development.
“清小搭”是清华大学自主研发、基于人工智能技术构建的全功能智能体学伴，2024年8月面向本科新生上线试用，2025年6月面向全体本研学生全面开放。
扫描下面二维码进行网页版登录或微信小程序登录；或微信搜索“清华大学学生成长助手清小搭”小程序进行使用。（目前处于试运行阶段，仅面向2024级本科生开放）
